title: fix: show restore guidance for retired session worktree reviews
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Opening Review for an old session whose worktree was cleaned up reports “Local workspace review owner changed,” which gives no useful recovery action.

## User Impact

Review now reports that the session's worktree was removed and directs the user to **Restore in Settings > Worktrees**, or to start a new session. Missing registry records receive the same guidance. Genuine owner, repository, branch, and checkout-path mismatches remain errors.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing local review owner combined removal and identity mismatches in one condition. Separate those outcomes and validate the registry even when no accepted review-base row remains. A valid live worktree without that row still uses the existing checkout-diff fallback. No new configuration, schema, or protocol state is needed.

The Control UI already displays request error messages through its existing diff-panel error boundary; no UI code changes or new unavailable-reason mapping are included.

## Evidence

The owning `sessions.diff` boundary regression was red on the original production code: expected `/worktree was removed.*Use Restore in Settings > Worktrees/`, received `Local workspace review owner changed`. With the fix, all **38 tests pass**, including removal at timestamp zero, a missing registry row without a review base, the genuine cwd-owner-change rejection, session-incarnation checks, and the live-worktree fallback.

- `pnpm test src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 38 passed; final wrapper wall time 51.24s (Vitest 46.36s, including compiler-output verification and synthetic Git/SQLite fixtures). Broad CI passed in 858s elapsed workflow time (including scheduling and all selected jobs): [run 44605692210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44605692210).
- `pnpm tsgo:core`: passed.
- Changed-path core test typecheck: `gateway-methods` passed in 3.6s; shard-size advisories only.
- Targeted oxlint, format check, docs link audit (0 broken links), and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Codex autoreview of the complete local change against `64416d16a2c8e431f2e6f77f55a160bbb768242c`, with relevant caller/source context, through P2: scoped-clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- pr-simplify: kept one existing decision owner; removed the conflated error branch and early validation bypass. Production delta **+1 line**, test delta **0 lines**, docs delta **+2 lines**. Existing identity cases were consolidated without dropping a contract.

All runtime proof used synthetic local fixtures. No production host or Gateway was contacted. Exact-head PR CI and hosted review passed; no live UI proof is claimed. Landed as `3668144435351996c43884a192b80dba46aaff11`.
